question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    CAST(p.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(SAFE_DIVIDE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1) * p.expansion_factor * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) as total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(SAFE_DIVIDE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 1) * p.expansion_factor * c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted IS NOT NULL
    AND c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted > 0
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    total_macroplot_acres,
    total_subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  CAST(condition_status_code AS STRING) as condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
